design:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a clean pixel-art CHARACTER MODEL SHEET for an elite male SNIPER, promoted from the archer in the reference. Reference image is our current archer palette/simplicity, NOT the new design or pose.
Four whole figures in a roomy 2x2 grid: top-left front three-quarter facing LEFT with a relaxed unstrung-pose hand holding longbow upright, top-right back view, bottom-left full LEFT profile, bottom-right full RIGHT profile.
Look stronger and more experienced than basic archer through broad ivory chest/shoulder protection, one clear ivory forearm bracer, fitted blue tunic with large simple ivory side panels, navy boots with ivory knee/shin plates, and a substantial tall recurved bow. Visible fit peach-skinned arms and face, clear dark eyes. Solid pure navy medium-short hair with a simple ivory headband, NO shiny hair. Brown back quiver with a small group of clearly drawn arrows. No cape, no shield, sword, crossbow or gun. Do not add a helmet that hides the face.
EXACT FIVE flat colors: navy #172638, blue #3976b5, warm ivory #e4e1c8, peach #dda77d, muted warm brown #8c6b45. Brown is the only extra color compared to archer, for bow grip, quiver and straps. Longbow has ivory curved limbs with brown grip and thin navy string. Body silhouette is agile and muscular with coherent LARGE blue/ivory areas, not ornate plate-knight armor or scattered white glitter. Four directions same identity/equipment. Small RPG sprite anatomy, about64-pixel-tall figure then nearest-neighbor enlargement. Flat matte pixel clusters, sparse detail, no gradient, glossy reflection, dithering or isolated white specks. Genuinely transparent background, no ground shadow, no words/labels. Full bow tips, arrow feathers and feet inside canvas with generous margins.

maps.map-idle-master.png:
Use case: style-transfer. Remake the exact native tactical-game poses in image1 as the promoted SNIPER from image2. Image1 = mandatory pose, object placement, silhouette and limb-phase guide. Image2 = identity, costume, five flat materials ONLY; do NOT copy its static stance or bow position over the native pose.
Keep pure navy hair, ivory headband, peach face and visible navy eyes, broad simple ivory chest/shoulder pieces, blue tunic with big ivory side panels, bare peach upper arms, ivory forearm/knee/shin guards, navy boots, brown strap/quiver, ivory recurved bow limbs and brown bow grip. Stronger than basic archer, still agile. No cape/shield/sword/gun.
EXACT five flat colors #172638 #3976b5 #e4e1c8 #dda77d #8c6b45. Pure solid hair, no highlights or gradients, no dither or white glitter. Simple coherent pixel clusters, approximately64px-tall full body before nearest-neighbor enlargement. Genuine transparent background, no ground shadow/words/labels. Leave margins around all bow tips and both feet. Keep each pair's fixed head, chest, belt and body scale at the same height; alternate legs without a whole-body bob. Interpret black areas of native as dark outline/occlusion, purple areas as cloth, white as skin/bow highlights.
THREE complete figures in one horizontal row matching image1 left-to-right source0,1,2. The native idle is a planted spread-legged stance, bow carried vertically on IMAGE RIGHT, NOT full draw/aim. Reproduce the small hand/forearm/shoulder pose differences at their exact source locations. Do NOT invent steps, extra arrows or shooting. All three have identical head/torso/pelvis/feet position and size, only the native upper-limb/bow adjustment changes. Bow top is near head height, bottom near knee, not a huge bow raised overhead. Free arm follows source across the torso. Eyes and skin remain visible.

Preserve native bent bow-holding arm and free-arm counterpose, not a frontal torso with sideways face. Turn chest, belt, shoulders, wrists, knees and toes in the direction of travel, with clear near/far shoulder perspective. battle_prepare.battle-prepare-master.png:
Use case: style-transfer. Production pixel-art animation sheet for a promoted SNIPER.
Image1 is EXACT native pose/order/weapon orientation reference; image2 is the same new character COSTUME ONLY. Rebuild every whole pose to match image1's arms, bow curvature/projection, feet and stance, not the model sheet's default stance. All figures face LEFT as in raw native reference. Preserve the native grounded human body and each bow pose.
Identity: pure navy hair, ivory headband, peach visible face and dark eye, simple ivory chest/shoulder protection over blue tunic with big ivory side panels, peach upper arms, ivory bracers and knee/shin guards, navy boots, brown diagonal strap and back quiver with ivory arrow feathers. Tall recurved longbow with ivory limbs, brown grip, thin navy string. No gun, crossbow stock, sword, shield, cloak or magic additions.
EXACT FIVE flat colors: #172638 #3976b5 #e4e1c8 #dda77d #8c6b45. Same five materials for all poses. No hair/clothing highlights, gradient, glints, dither or scattered white specks. Clear broad color areas. SNES-style crisp small sprites, about80 pixels tall for head-to-foot (bow may extend higher), nearest-neighbor enlarged. Genuine transparent background, no ground shadow, no text/labels, ample padding around feet, bow tips and feather tips. Foreground bowstrings/arrows must be clearly attached to bow and hands, no missing finger, fused limbs or extra firing arrows.
SIX poses in a 3-column by2-row grid EXACT same order as reference:
top-left source1: narrow upright relaxed stance, bow LOWERED to image RIGHT beside hip, hands down, no arrow drawn.
top-middle source2: take wide stable stance, bow still lowered right, begin prepare.
top-right source10: bow swung toward IMAGE LEFT at chest level, curved limbs seen foreshortened into a short oval, bent bow arm.
bottom-left source11: raise the bow arm out to IMAGE LEFT, bow now long upright and slightly oblique, full extended limbs.
bottom-middle source12: upright bow on IMAGE LEFT, bow hand extended left, drawing hand near string at mid-chest, string still straight, arrow horizontal.
bottom-right source13: begin drawing, drawing hand moves right towards face, bow stays tall vertical, head and legs same as source12.
Native white diagonal behind head is quiver arrows, NOT a sword or head horn. Never shoot yet; these are preparation phases. Keep bow LOWERED on RIGHT in first two figures, then raise to LEFT in others. Do not pose all six with the bow already aimed.
